subject: Acarbose Preserves Spatial Memory in Aging Mice but Fails Against Alzheimer's Pathology
script: From Agewell Brief: Acarbose Preserves Spatial Memory in Aging Mice but Fails Against Alzheimer's Pathology. A metabolic decelerator protects hippocampal circuits during normal physiological aging yet leaves amyloid-driven pathology untouched, proving that neurodegeneration diverges fundamentally from standard senescence. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
